question: The larger of two supplementary angles is 16° more than the smaller angle. The smaller angle (in degrees) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two supplementary angles, their total sum is always 180°.

Smaller angle = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2

Smaller angle = (180° − 16°) ÷ 2

Smaller angle = 164° ÷ 2 = 82°

**∴ The correct answer is 82°.**
